content.title: Rory McIlroy net worth: What is Rory McIlroy's net worth in 2025?
content.text: Rory McIlroy is one of the best golfers on the planet so it's no surprise he's one of the richest.Only the man himself knows his true net worth, but we can have a good guess at just how much money the golf star has. As of April 2025, McIlroy has collected just shy of $105m in official PGA Tour prize money.His 2025 Masters win not only earned him the career Grand Slam but also awarded him $4.2m in prize money.As of November 2024, McIlroy's career earnings on the DP World Tour were just under €60m. Add to the fact that he’s got vast sponsorship deals with Nike, TaylorMade, Omega, Workday and others, it is understandable to assume he is worth a fortune.And let's not forget McIlroy jets around the world in a private jet he bought for $30m!Scroll down this page to check out what McIlroy's estimated net worth is in 2025.Let’s break it down... Rory McIlroy Rory McIlroy Net Worth 2025SalaryMcIlroy placed second on the Forbes list of the highest-paid golfers last season. According to Spotrac, Rory McIlroy’s total career earnings are $185m as of April 2025 - $27.67m from Major Championships, $76.57m from official events, $1.89m from unofficial events, $40.15m from Tour Championships, $30.5m from Player Impact Program, and $8.9m from Tour Top 10. Rory McIlroy EndorsementsAccording to Forbes, McIlroy has sponsorship deals with Nike, TaylorMade, Omega, Optum, GolfPass and Workday, earning him $45-50m.The Northern Irishman agreed an endorsement contract with Nike in 2013, that was worth between $100-250m.That contract was extended in 2017 for a further 10 years.So it will be interesting to see what happens between McIlroy and Nike when his contract runs out in 2027.Tiger Woods left Nike in 2024 to set up his own apparel and footwear brand, Sun Day Red.It remains to be seen whether McIlroy will stick with Nike or go down a similar route as Woods. During the early days of his pro career, McIlroy was also using Nike clubs but the brand discontinued making golf equipment in 2017.That allowed McIlroy to negotiate an equipment contract with TaylorMade, said to be worth in the region of $100m.The Northern Irishman extended his contract with TaylorMade in May 2022. McIlroy has also teamed up with NBC Sports on Golfpass, Bose Sound Systems, Oakley, Santander Bank, and Piguet.InvestmentsIn 2022, McIlroy co-founded TMRW Sports alongside Woods.TMRW Sports then launched TGL, which started up in 2025. GolfMagic has already written everything you need to know about TGL, the tech-forward, primetime golf league that features the PGA Tour's top talent.McIlroy and Woods' TGL teams endured a debut season to forget as both Boston Common Golf and Jupiter Links GC missed out on the Playoffs. In June 2024, TMRW Sports was valued at $500m.In 2019, he set up Symphony Ventures. The primary purpose of the fund was to invest in emerging companies. One of those is the fitness tech company Whoop. When McIlroy invested in Whoop, it was worth $1.2bn. The valuation has since grown exponentially. He's also invested in Future, a one-on-one digital fitness training platform and health companies called LetsGetChecked and Kaia Health.Troon, the largest golf management company, also has McIlroy's money behind it.RORY MCILROY BIOD.O.B04.05.1989Height5'10"Weight160lbs (73kg)Place of birthHolywood, Northern IrelandResidenceJupiter, FloridaTurned Pro2007PGA Tour wins29Major wins5 Rory McIlroy Formula 1In October 2023, McIlroy joined the backers of F1 team Alpine. He was part of a $217m strategic investment into the team led by the consortium Otro Capital. Joining McIlroy in that move was boxer Anthony Joshua and footballer Trent Alexander-Arnold.McIlroy said he was open to the idea of investing in his beloved football team, Manchester United, at some point in the future."Sports team ownership used to be limited to private equity, and people who had a ton of money," said McIlroy. "But now sports stars are becoming more savvy and using their money in the right way." Rory McIlroy What does Rory McIlroy spend his money on?According to realtor.com, he currently resides in a 9,000-square-foot mansion that’s part of Jack Nicklaus’ exclusive golf community, The Bear’s Club.Estimated to be worth more than $16m, it has nine bedrooms, 10.5 bathrooms, a recording studio, guest house, outdoor kitchen, pool, and spa - and calls Serena Williams and Michael Jordan neighbours. Rory McIlroy PGA Tour bonusesThe PGA Tour introduced the Player Impact Program (PIP) in 2021. In short, it rewards players with cash for boosting engagement and publicity of the PGA Tour. It will come as no surprise to you that McIlroy has made some big bucks here. Woods proved he still moved the needle in the inaugural PIP, scooping $8m. McIlroy placed third and was given $3.5m. In 2022, Woods was the top dog again as the PIP was expanded to reward the top 20 players. Woods was given an almighty $15m, whereas McIlroy finished second, earning $12m. McIlroy was also the beneficiary of another huge wedge of cash after he remained loyal to the PGA Tour amid the schism with LIV Golf. In April 2024, he was reportedly told he was the beneficiary of an equity share in PGA Tour Enterprises worth $50m. McIlroy finished third in the 2024 PIP race and earned $4.5m.Woods took the top prize once again, narrowly ahead of World No.1 Scottie Scheffler in second. Rory McIlroy What is Rory McIlroy's net worth in 2025?Rory McIlroy's net worth heading into 2025 is estimated to be $83m, according to Forbes.The publication ranked McIlroy in the top 20 for the highest paid athletes in the world.Ahead of him in that list were Cristiano Ronaldo, Jon Rahm, Lionel Messi, LeBron James, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Kylian Mbappe, Neymar, Karim Benzema, Stephen Curry, Lamar Jackson, Joe Burrow, Kevin Durant, Shohei Ohtani, Canelo Alvarez, Patrick Mahomes, Anthony Joshua, Max Verstappen and Aaron Rodgers. However the Sunday Times Rich List recently reported Mcllroy's net worth has now soared to a gigantic $290m (£225m).
